memories.author: D06
memories.text:
function: reports mild low back pain radiating to left thigh, able to walk 2 km, performs ADLs independently.
cognition: Mini-Cog 4/5 (recall 3 items, clock draw normal).
falls: no falls in past 12 months; gait steady; timed up-and-go 9 seconds (normal).
medicines: 3 regular (pregabalin 75 mg BD, diclofenac 50 mg BD after food, methylcobalamin 1500 mcg OD).
mood: denies low mood or anxiety; PHQ-2 0.
carers: wife Priya, spouse.
goals: "I want to walk without pain and continue working at the jewellery shop."

memories.author: D06
memories.text:
pregabalin 75 mg twice daily
 diclofenac 50 mg twice daily after food
 methylcobalamin 1500 mcg once daily

memories.author: lab
memories.text:
Hemoglobin 14.2 g/L (13-17)
 WBC 6.8 x10^9/L (4-10)
 Platelets 210 x10^9/L (150-400)
 Serum creatinine 0.9 mg/dL (0.6-1.2)
 ALT 22 U/L (<40)
 Vitamin D 18 ng/mL (30-100) – low

memories.author: D06
memories.text: MRI lumbar spine: L4-L5 disc bulge causing mild left foraminal narrowing; no cord compression. Impression: mild lumbar radiculopathy consistent with left-sided sciatica.

memories.author: front_desk
memories.text: Follow-up appointment booked for 2025-07-10 at 10:00 with Dr Nandini Kulkarni.

memories.author: patient
memories.text: Pain in left leg has increased over past two weeks, especially after standing for >30 minutes at work. Took extra diclofenac twice, helped briefly.

memories.author: D06
memories.text:
function: pain now 6/10 on VAS, limits standing to 20 minutes; still manages shop duties with occasional rest.
cognition: Mini-Cog 4/5 (stable).
falls: no falls; gait antalgic left side; timed up-and-go 11 seconds (borderline).
medicines: 3 regular (pregabalin 75 mg BD, diclofenac 50 mg BD after food, methylcobalamin 1500 mcg OD).
mood: reports frustration, PHQ-2 1.
carers: wife Priya, spouse.
goals: "I need relief to work full days without pain."

memories.author: D06
memories.text:
pregabalin increased to 150 mg twice daily
 diclofenac 50 mg twice daily after food
 methylcobalamin 1500 mcg once daily

memories.author: lab
memories.text:
Vitamin D 22 ng/mL (30-100) – still low
 Calcium 9.2 mg/dL (8.5-10.5)
 PTH 45 pg/mL (15-65)

memories.author: D06
memories.text: X-ray lumbar spine (AP and lateral): L4-L5 disc space narrowing, osteophyte formation at margins. No fracture or significant vertebral body abnormality.

memories.author: D06
memories.text: Referred to Physiotherapy Department, Bangalore General Hospital, for core strengthening and lumbar traction. Requested 6 sessions over 8 weeks.

memories.author: D06
memories.text: Physiotherapy report: patient attended 5 sessions, improved lumbar flexion, pain reduced to 4/10. Advised home exercise program and proper footwear.

memories.author: D06
memories.text:
function: pain 3/10, able to stand 45 minutes, walks 3 km with occasional discomfort.
cognition: Mini-Cog 4/5 (annual screen).
falls: no falls; gait normal; timed up-and-go 9 seconds (normal).
medicines: 4 regular (pregabalin 150 mg BD, diclofenac 50 mg BD after food, methylcobalamin 1500 mcg OD, cholecalciferol 1000 IU OD).
mood: improved, PHQ-2 0.
carers: wife Priya, spouse.
goals: "I want to be pain‑free and continue my work without limitations."

memories.text:
pregabalin 150 mg twice daily
 diclofenac 50 mg twice daily after food

 CBC: Hb 14.0, WBC 7.0, Platelets 210

memories.author: front_desk
memories.text: Appointment changed from 2026-04-15 to 2026-04-01 at 09:30 for review with Dr Nandini Kulkarni.
